evidence_snippets: Should be in the format `projects/[kms_project_id]/locations/[region]/keyRings/[key_ring_id]/cryptoKeys/[key]`. replication.auto.customerManagedEncryption.kmsKeyRef.name Optional string The `name` of a `KMSCryptoKey` resource. replication.auto.customerManagedEncryption.kmsKeyRef.namespace Optional string The `namespace` of a `KMSCryptoKey` resource. replication.automatic Optional boolean The Secret will automatically be replicated without any restrictions. replication.userManaged Optional object The [Secret][google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.Secret] will only be replicated into the locations specified. replication.userManaged.replicas Required* list (object) Required.

The replication policy cannot be changed after the Secret has been created. replication.auto Optional object The [Secret][google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.Secret] will automatically be replicated without any restrictions. replication.auto.customerManagedEncryption Optional object Optional.
For secrets using the [Automatic][google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.Replication.Automatic] replication policy type, Cloud KMS CryptoKeys must reside in `global`.
